versification: R. H. Charles source numbering normalized to logical chapters 1-108 and contiguous integer verses; lettered subverses and parallel E/G^g readings are preserved in merged text/source_parts

verses.text_en: And in those days I will open the store chambers of blessing which are in the heaven, so as to send them down ⌜upon the earth⌝ over the work and labour of the children of men.
verses.text_hr: U one dane otvorit ću riznice blagoslova na nebu da ih pošaljem ⌜na zemlju⌝, na djelo i trud sinova ljudskih.

verses.text_en: And truth and peace shall be associated together throughout all the days of the world and throughout all the generations =of men=.’
verses.text_hr: Istina i mir bit će združeni kroz sve dane svijeta i kroz sve naraštaje =ljudi=.’
